title: coryphantha pallida subsp. calipensis
intro: Coryphantha pallida subsp. calipensis, commonly known as White Pincushion Cactus, is a subspecies of cactus native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing, making it useful in the treatment of various health conditions such as burns, cuts, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Coryphantha pallida subsp. calipensis are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant's extracts have been reported to have antiseptic and antifungal effects, contributing to its therapeutic applications.
